_comment: DRAFT - not wired into any loader. Migration of config/drafts/crops_fantasy_v1.json to the v2 schema of config/drafts/crops_earthlike_v2.json. Every entry sets 'analog' to a v2 real-crop id (or, for ember_pepper, a named EcoCrop record deliberately excluded from the real catalogue) and inherits that record's RE-DERIVED 2023 envelope shifted along EXACTLY ONE axis, per the 'one twist deep' rule in docs/FUTURE_WORK_SCOPING.md SS G1b. The axis is named in envelope_ref and in notes. envelope_source is 'estimated' for all of them because the shift is authored. The v1 single frost_kills_at_c field is replaced by the frost_kills_at_c / winter_hardy_to_c pair, shifted by the same delta as the temperature axis; where FAO recorded 'no input' the fantasy crop inherits null rather than inventing a number. sphere_tags and affinities are carried unchanged. | 2026-08-02: removed ember_pepper, silverleaf, skywheat as reskins (no mechanical distinction from real crops). Per-world reskins are world-customization content, not default catalog entries.

crops.name: frostwheat
crops.envelope_ref: wheat_bread / wheat, bread wheat (Triticum aestivum), EcoCrop 2114, shifted -12 C on the temperature axis only
crops.notes: Twist axis: TEMPERATURE, -12 C. Re-derived on the v2 split: v1 carried a single KTMP -28 that conflated two things. It now reads frost_kills -12 (a growing plant dies at -12) and winter_hardy -32 (a hardened dormant plant survives to -32), both the bread-wheat values shifted by the same 12 C. Precip, cycle, pH and soil are wheat's EcoCrop record verbatim - the v0 draft's lower water need was a second twist and stays dropped. Yield 0.9 t/ha against wheat's 1.2 is the price.

crops.name: cave fungus
crops.envelope_ref: potato / potato (Solanum tuberosum), EcoCrop 1971, with the light axis alone collapsed to zero
crops.notes: Twist axis: LIGHT (light_min -> 0.0). v1 pointed at 'highland-tuber', an id that no longer exists: v2 splits that into potato (S. tuberosum) and bitter_potato (S. x juzepczukii), and the correct analog is the lowland potato, whose temp/precip/pH/cycle envelope is inherited unchanged. winter_hardy_to_c is null because the potato has no overwintering field phase - and a cave has no winter. biome_whitelist stays non-null per the schema's Anno-style fantasy-only gate. NOTE: its 'fungus' good is not in the trade-good catalogue or in the v2 proposedGoods list; it needs one before this crop can be wired up.

crops.name: duskvine
crops.envelope_ref: grape / grape, raisin (Vitis vinifera), EcoCrop 2160, with the light axis alone lowered to deep shade
crops.notes: Twist axis: LIGHT (grape 0.5 -> 0.08). Ripens under closed canopy and on north faces, the one piece of ground a vine never gets. Re-derived envelope now carries the grape's real split - frost_kills -3, winter_hardy -20 - so a duskvine survives a continental winter and still loses its crop to a May frost, exactly like a real vine. Cost paid in labour (185 d/ha vs 160) per the G1b rule that fantasy pays in a real currency.

crops.name: mireroot
crops.envelope_ref: taro / taro, eddo (Colocasia esculenta), EcoCrop 758, shifted +60% on the water axis only (precip x1.6, drainage narrowed to permanently saturated)
crops.notes: Twist axis: WATER. Temperature, pH and cycle are taro's v2 record verbatim. Both killing-temperature columns are 'no input' for taro, so mireroot inherits nulls; the Notes field's '180-210 frost-free days' is the real constraint and is a call-site check, not a number here. RMIN 1600 mm makes it the wettest crop in either catalogue apart from black pepper.
